programs.notes: COCRDUPC is the Credit Card Update program. It COPYs CVCRD01Y (CC-ACCT-ID/CC-ACCT-ID-N) and COCOM01Y (CDEMO-ACCT-ID). Three new local aliases confirmed: CCUP-OLD-ACCTID (saves CC-ACCT-ID across pseudo-conversational turns), CCUP-NEW-ACCTID (screen input staging), CARD-UPDATE-ACCT-ID (written to VSAM via REWRITE).
